tools.description: DEFAULT FIRST-USE TOOL. Give ATL the user's natural-language task. tools.name: atl_decide
tools.description: ADVANCED ROUTING-ONLY TOOL. Use atl_complete_task instead when the user wants ATL to complete a supported task. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "atl_decide" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
